YAY - YOU'RE HERE! 

I'm Carrie, a tv host from Wisconsin living in Kansas City, Missouri. Here you'll find a new video once a week - typically about my advocacy work in animal rescue, my job as a tv host, books I'm reading, clothes i'm thrifting, or just regular life things. I hope you stick around! 

xx

-Carrie
